spec.benchmark: Zero-slope null: the target leg's CAR is unrelated to the DGS10 CAR across events (intercept-only model)
spec.cost_model: No cost gate: an event study measures announcement responses, not a forecast; there is no trading rule to cost
spec.description: FOMC cross-event transmission: target-leg CARs on DGS10 CAR across scheduled FOMC meetings (cross-section OLS, HC0)
model_definition: Cross-event OLS of the target leg's CAR[0,+1] on the DGS10 CAR[0,+1], heteroskedasticity-consistent (HC0) standard errors via newey_west_hac with max_lag=0
One-sided primary p-value derived from the HAC t-statistic as Phi(t) for the 'less than' direction; two-sided p-values for the VIX and BAA10Y slopes
Holm family of 3 tests (a SPX on DGS10, b VIX on DGS10, c BAA10Y on DGS10)

Split-half replication: events ordered chronologically, first half = first floor(n/2) events, second half = the rest; replication requires both halves to show a negative slope with a one-sided HC0 p-value below 0.05
Descriptive extended-sample regressions (non-TYVIX legs to 2026-11-16), not in the test family
